blind.description: A rectangular wooden shop counter featuring paneled wooden sides and a planked top. Displayed on top are various general store wares: two tied burlap sacks, two terracotta/clay lidded jars, a coiled brown rope, a small black metal lantern, a round yellow wheel of cheese, a stack of folded red-and-white checkered cloth, and a wide wooden bucket. The model is solid, stylized, and continuous with clean geometry and hand-painted style textures.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden tabletop divided into planks, with the top section bare wood and the lower two-thirds crowded with a folded checkered textile, a bright yellow circular cheese wheel, a coiled rope, a dark square lantern, a circular bucket, two red circular jar lids, and two tan gathered sacks.
blind.height_vs_figure: The counter table stands roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 2.5 to 3 ft high), with items reaching slightly higher; the table is approximately 5 to 6 ft long and 2.5 ft wide.
